name: Eye Guy
abilities: Optic energy blasts from any of ~20 body eyes
Merges eyes into one large charged chest-eye beam (shatters Rock Monsters)
360-degree vision; palm eyes see round corners
Elemental variants: fire blasts, freeze rays, electric bolts, sticky eye-goop
Ophthalmokinesis - moves eyes across his body
weaknesses: Irritants (Gracklflint venom, cologne) blind and burn his many eyes
summary: A tan Opticoid with eyes everywhere except his face, firing energy, fire, ice, lightning or goo from any of them.
traits: No eyes on his face - just a mouth and bat-like ears
Chest eye replaced by the Ultimatrix in the UA intro
notableFeats: Battled the Negative 10 in his debut (Ben 10 vs. Negative 10: Part 2)
Destroyed Dr. Animo's DNA bomb (Secret of the Omnitrix, Gold Edition)
Fought Negative Ultimate Humungousaur (The Ultimate Heist)
Stabilised the Plumber HQ power core with Gwen (Mud is Thicker Than Water)
Defeated Mad Rook with Freeze-Ghost (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2)
Defeated a possessed Max as an 11-year-old (From Hedorium to Eternity)

appearances.designNotes: Light-green eyes with dark-green pupils, one giant primary eye in the chest, black pants with white bands, white belt with the original Omnitrix.

image.label: OS
image.notes: Official Original Series model sheet pose (chest eye closed), transparent background. Verified 2026-08-17.

appearances.designNotes: Bigger, brighter, symmetrically placed eyes; chest eye closed by default; extra palm eyes; green pant cuffs and hand cuffs, green Omnitrix belt with white stripe. 11-year-old: OS look with the new eye layout, white bands and a green Omnitrix.

scoring.rationale: A walking arsenal of energy, fire, ice, electric and goop beams with all-round vision, so he handles most ranged fights; physically ordinary and easily blinded by irritants.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (removed from the playlist) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
Also used by Ben 23 and Weapon XI (Kevin) - not counted.
